title: HEPA Filter Replacement
shortDescription: Coway Airmega HEPA filter needs replacement.
fullDescription:
A solid red filter indicator means the true HEPA filter is at end of life. Coway filters last about 12 months based on usage.

Replace and reset.

faq.a: Yes, Max-2 combines HEPA and carbon.

title: Carbon Filter Service Soon
shortDescription: Carbon pre-filter nearing end of life.
fullDescription: A flashing or solid yellow filter light means the carbon deodorization filter is nearing replacement. Typically 6 months.

title: Dust Sensor Error
fullDescription:
E1 appears when the particulate sensor lens is dirty or sensor has failed self-test.

Clean the sensor lens with a dry cotton swab.

fixSteps.title: Locate sensor door
fixSteps.instruction: Open sensor access on side of unit.

title: Fan Motor Error
fullDescription: E2 indicates fan motor has stalled or exceeded current limit. Check for obstruction.

faq.a: Check serial; Coway offers 5-year motor warranty on many units.

title: Wi-Fi Disconnected
fullDescription: Coway smart models use IoCare. WF indicates Wi-Fi loss.

fixSteps.title: Re-pair
fixSteps.instruction: Hold Wi-Fi button 3 seconds, follow IoCare setup.

title: Auto Mode Disabled
shortDescription: Auto mode unavailable due to sensor.
fullDescription: If E1 is present, auto mode cannot operate. Fix sensor then re-enable auto.

title: Air Quality Ring Stuck Red
shortDescription: Ring indicator stays red even in clean air.
fullDescription: If AQI ring stays red after purifier runs for hours, the dust sensor may be dirty, giving false high readings. Clean sensor.

fixSteps.title: Clean sensor
fixSteps.instruction: Access via side door, swab lens.

videoSearchQuery: Coway air quality ring stuck red

title: Rattling or Grinding Sound
fullDescription:
Sounds typically come from a misaligned filter or dust buildup on the fan.

Reseat filter and vacuum intake.

faq.a: Yes, on higher speeds you hear airflow.

title: Musty Smell from Purifier
fullDescription: Carbon filter saturation causes odor release. Replace carbon filter and optionally sun-dry the HEPA briefly.

title: Ionizer Module Error
fullDescription: Ionizer modules can self-disable when dusty. Clean the ionizer pins with a dry cloth.

fixSteps.title: Clean pins
fixSteps.instruction: Wipe ionizer pins with dry cloth.

faq.a: Yes when unplugged; damp cloth can damage, use dry.
